bullets: Asia rallied on AI optimism (Nikkei +2.2%, Kospi +4%) after a Wall Street advance; US futures mixed-to-higher into FOMC.
FOMC decision Wed Oct 28: markets price ~90% odds of a hold at 4.00%; press conference key for rate-path signal.
Oil eased (Brent -0.8%) on Mideast diplomatic progress; VIX down ~5.4%, signaling calmer risk appetite.
Anthropic's IPO filing is lifting AI-stock sentiment; Core PCE and Advance GDP due Thu Oct 29 ahead of the Fed.

NEM.why: NEM fell with the whole gold-miner sector (GDX -2%) as spot gold slid toward $4,000 on rising yields/dollar, not company damage. Q3 beat estimates with record profit and a large buyback. Only one small broker (Freedom Broker) downgraded on cost inflation; Citi and Barclays raised targets the same week.
NEM.bull: Record Q3 profit, big buyback, Citi/Barclays raised targets despite the gold pullback.
NEM.bear: Freedom Broker downgrade flags real cost inflation and Q4 FCF shortfall risk at Lihir/Cadia.
NEM.catalysts: No company-specific event found; FOMC decision Oct 28 and gold-price direction are the main swing factors.
flags: one downgrade vs two target hikes

MAT.why: Drop driven by company turmoil: Citi downgraded MAT to Neutral (10/14) on guidance/cost concerns, CEO Kreiz departed Sep 29, and Southeastern Asset Management is pushing a proxy fight to force a sale. Recent bounce is on takeover speculation (Authentic Brands, Zuru), not improved fundamentals.
MAT.bull: Takeover interest from Authentic Brands/Zuru near $20+/share sets a valuation floor and pressures the board.
MAT.bear: Citi downgrade, CEO exit, and an active proxy fight show real governance and guidance damage, not a sector dip.
MAT.catalysts: Q3 earnings expected within the hold window (desk data: ~7 trading days out); proxy-fight headlines possible anytime.
